summary: This clinical research study compares two different semaglutide medicines in adults with type 2 diabetes, a condition where the body has trouble managing blood sugar. The trial looks at how well these treatments control blood sugar levels by measuring changes in glycosylated hemoglobin, which is a blood test showing average blood sugar over time. Participants receive a weekly injection of one of the study drugs for 28 weeks. The study is sponsored by Novo Nordisk A/S and has reached a Completed status.
